sections.changelog:
Fixed

  • **MVweb Hub menu class upgraded to the newest-wins loader (2.5.0) and Russian hub strings restored.** The bundled `class-mvweb-menu.php` previously won only if it loaded first; if an alphabetically-earlier plugin shipped an older copy, that older one took over and the hub lost its available-plugins promo. The bundled class now uses a two-phase loader that declares the highest-versioned copy regardless of load order. Also refreshed the bundled `mvweb-hub-ru_RU` translation, whose compiled `.mo` lagged behind the source and left the hub hero and section headings in English on ru_RU.
